root_cause.text: ceph_mds_auth_match() dereferences fs_name obtained from `mount_options->mds_namespace`, which can be NULL when no mds_namespace is specified, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in `strcmp()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the issue "if fs_name == NULL" and shows the original code: `const char *fs_name = mdsc->fsc->mount_options->mds_namespace; ... if (auth->match.fs_name && strcmp(auth->match.fs_name, fs_name))`. The patch replaces that with `mdsc->mdsmap->m_fs_name`, which is always set (either decoded from MDSMap or defaulting to "cephfs"), and introduces `ceph_namespace_match()` that safely handles a NULL pattern.
